result.description: Prodoz International Pty Ltd   About the Role   We are seeking an experienced  Agricultural Technician  to join our growing team based in Bunbury, Western Australia.  This role will support growers through the implementation of crop production programs, field trials and agricultural technologies. Working closely with customers, agronomists, researchers and management, you will provide practical technical support, monitor product performance and assist with the testing and continuous improvement of innovative agricultural solutions.   Key Responsibilities    Provide technical support to growers in relation to crop production, soil management and agricultural technologies.  Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot agricultural technology and equipment used in crop production.  Conduct field trials and product evaluations to assess the performance of fertilisers, soil conditioners, bio-stimulants and horticultural products.  Collect, record and analyse field data, preparing technical reports and recommendations.  Monitor crop performance, soil conditions and field trial outcomes.  Assist with research, testing and product development activities.  Diagnose technical issues and recommend practical solutions to improve crop performance.  Support the implementation of precision agriculture and other advanced farming technologies.  Liaise with growers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to deliver technical advice and ongoing support.  Conduct product demonstrations and provide technical guidance to customers.  Maintain accurate records of field activities, trial results and service reports.  Travel throughout the region to visit customers and trial sites as required.    Skills and Experience   To be successful in this role, you will have:   Sound knowledge of crop production systems, soil management and sustainable farming practices.  Experience conducting field trials, collecting technical data and preparing reports.  Experience using or supporting agricultural technologies, precision agriculture systems or related agricultural equipment.  Strong diagnostic, analytical and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and relationship management skills.  Well-developed organisational skills and the ability to work independently.  Proficiency using computer software for technical reporting and data management.    What We Offer    Company vehicle, laptop and mobile phone.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Opportunity to work with innovative agricultural technologies and industry-leading products.  Supportive team environment with opportunities for long-term career development.   If you have a passion for agriculture, enjoy solving technical challenges and want to work with innovative farming solutions, we encourage you to apply. result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Administrative Officer - Identification and Merge Management (520557)





 Department of Health

 Health ICT

 HICT - Digital Technology Services Group





 Applications must be submitted by Sunday 26 July, 2026 11:55 PM 




Position details




 

 

 
Applications close:

 
Sunday 26 July, 2026 11:55 PM AEST

 

 

 
Award-Classification:

 
Health and Human Services (Tasmanian State Service) Award, General Stream, Band 3

 

 

Salary:

$76,849 to $82,996 per annum


 
 

 
Employment type:

 
Fixed-term, full-time

 

 

 
Region:

 
North West

 

 

Located in:

Mersey Community Hospital


 

 
Job description:

 
Join a supportive team and help ensure the accuracy and integrity of Tasmania's health information systems. Use your attention to detail to resolve data issues, improve record quality, and support reliable patient information across the health service.

 

 






 

The Team

This position is part of a small, supportive team that works closely together to deliver high-quality health information and administrative services. Team members are encouraged to share knowledge, support one another, and contribute ideas to continually improve processes and service delivery. The role offers the opportunity to work collaboratively while also exercising initiative and autonomy in day-to-day responsibilities.

The Role

Participate in the day to day identification, review and management of potential duplicate records according to documented processes.

Merge identified duplicate records in the PAS, ensuring that associated data in downstream systems attached to the Tasmanian Health Client Index (THCI) are handled appropriately, including provision of merge notification to System Administrators where necessary.

Run reports which support the management of the identification systems and assist users in resolving data integrity problems.

You will need

Knowledge and practical experience in medical records management, including the use of computerised health information systems.

High level interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to show initiative and discretion, and maintain confidentiality.

Experience in the use of various software packages for the production of reports, spreadsheets and databases, with the ability to undertake analysis of data and reports, and the ability to learn new software applications.

About Us

JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon.

JBS Australia’s Northern Division operates five strategically placed processing facilities as well as five feedlots across Queensland and New South Wales, with access to an extensive network of quality cattle. Our network provides the ability to meet the specific demands of various market segments with an extensive range of grain-fed and pasture-fed products. With approximately 15,000 employees spread across our offices, processing plants and feedlots, JBS Australia exports to more than 50 countries around the world.

About the Role

An exciting opportunity is opening for a maintenance planner for our Dinmore Site, it is a full-time role and responsible for our Dinmore site Maintenance related tasks. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

The maintenance planer is responsible for a wide range of engineering and maintenance activities associated with the operations of multiple cattle feedlots. The maintenance planner develops and implements long-term and short-term maintenance plans for all mechanical and electrical equipment to optimize feedlot safety, quality, equipment availability, and reliability outcomes. The role provides direction and guidance to the feedlot maintenance team members to ensure the safe and efficient maintenance and repair of the electrical and mechanical assets. Additionally, the role identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities in processes, systems, and equipment, and manages nominated capital projects.

Reporting to the plant engineer, this is a leadership position within the maintenance team. The position is hands-on, requires extensive maintenance and equipment knowledge, provides equipment solutions using sound maintenance principles, and requires the ability to lead and develop maintenance crew team members.

 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

· Facilitate maintenance to ensure production requirements are met.

· Ensure all requested and scheduled tasks are investigated, planned, executed, completed, and closed out on time and on budget.

· Prepare and order necessary spare parts and materials for planned tasks.

· Monitor spare parts holdings and the condition of critical spares.

· Develop and maintain the sap pm equipment register (functional locations).

· Monitor maintenance employee timesheets and follow up on any comments and recommendations.

· Plan, schedule, and monitor completion of maintenance work orders.

· Program and ensure all statutory requirements are met.

· Plan, schedule, and coordinate all major repair tasks in conjunction with the feedlot engineer.

· Ensure all documentation and schematics are securely retained, updated, and maintained as required.

· Coordinate teams of trades and non-trades personnel and external contractors.

· Ensure company procedures are supported and adhered to, i.e., permits to work, hot work permits, isolation and locking out, risk assessments, live work procedures, incident reporting, etc.

· Support, coordinate, and control ongoing maintenance and capital works planning and coordination functions for all areas of the feedlot.

· Facilitate and develop the processes required to analyze downtime.

· Produce actions to fix root cause and prevent failures from reoccurring.

· Development of effective contractor management systems including performance auditing.

· Assist in the delivery of projects and maintenance services.

· Implement minor projects and commissioning.

· Resolve issues and improve the existing and future feedlot systems.

· Develop systems and practices to maximize the benefit of the sap pm maintenance management system.

· Communicate with operations personnel on maintenance issues.

· Provide in-house training to other staff on the planning and scheduling systems.

· Organize and schedule maintenance training as required.

· Provide information for maintenance management reporting.

· Dealing with a multitude of tasks and demands at the one time with limited resources.

· Dealing with a wide range of people with varying levels of skills.

· Identifying and implementing solutions to quickly address feedlot breakdowns.

About you:

· A thorough understanding of work planning and scheduling procedures using sap pm.

· A thorough understanding of maintenance work management practices.

· Advanced electrical or mechanical trade or post-trade qualifications and experience.

· Experience in maintenance in a feedlot environment, desired but not essential.

· Proven ability to lead, manage, and motivate employees.

· The ability to lead and motivate people to continuously improve.

· Experience gained from a large heavy industrial organization.

· Extensive computer skills.

· Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills.

· Effective problem-solving capacity.

· Sound knowledge of OH&S regulations.

The ad is valid for 28 days.
